notes: CHART: the packet already flagged the contradiction (Kassadin wins 52.47% but the chart gave Katarina 6 of 7 stages), and on top of that the two layers disagreed on rows 2-5: full read Skill four times while content read Katarina. I resolved it as one atomic group — rows 2-3 become Katarina in the full layer (content already said Katarina), rows 4-5 become Skill in the content layer (full already said Skill), whys rewritten on both sides to match. That leaves Katarina/Katarina/Katarina/Katarina/Skill/Skill/Kassadin with no cross-layer disagreement left. TWO FACT ERRORS SHIPPED: (1) the page opened by calling Katarina an 'AD assassin' whose damage 'skips your shield' — Riot's text makes Voracity's dagger, Bouncing Blade and Death Lotus magic damage, so Void Stone and the Q shield are both live and the advice was inverted; (2) 'Q silence' again — Q interrupts channels, and Death Lotus IS a channel, so the outcome was right but the mechanism was wrong and would mislead a reader into expecting a silence on her Q or E. Also killed 'Sinister Steel', which is not in her kit (her W is Preparation). NOT ASSERTED: the kit file gives Bouncing Blade a derived 'grounding' flag and missingInteractions accordingly claims her Q can deny Riftwalk. Riot's own description of Bouncing Blade is a dagger that bounces and lands on the ground — no grounding — so per the brief's rule I trusted the description and wrote nothing about it. | COHERENCE: 1 chart edit(s) withdrawn — they moved the row to the enemy while leaving the phase why describing the owner winning it. Chart authority is an open question, so the label was reverted rather than the prose rewritten. Re-propose only as a side+why pair.
